externalReply.text: Selma, Noor Voss owns this response and will send a written category matrix by 14:30 UTC today, ahead of your 15:30 call and tomorrow’s 10:00 review. The all-data questionnaire and the Friday zero-downtime promise were broader than the service facts support. The team is correcting those statements. Your production documents, database and routine recovery replicas are currently in Frankfurt and Dublin; the console’s EU label covers those stores.

Global identity and US security telemetry are separate. A trial support attachment is in a US store, and the retained audit summary shows overseas assignment and attachment rendering. It does not establish every individual viewer or exclude older access. The trial spreadsheet contains some real supplier contact information. The team cannot certify that all service data and all access have always remained in the EU. The annex’s scope and notification questions remain under Legal and Privacy review.

The proposed interim course is to keep the current workspace operating while limiting new exposure and testing what a supported regional change could accomplish. Pavel may disable PDF Preview after saving the job manifest under your existing instruction. Noor will request EU routing for this case, stage the approved reduced-field telemetry setting, and report whether each control is actually applied. Those steps do not erase existing vendor copies, move the global directory or make remaining telemetry regional. No production cutover or deletion will occur without the required approvals.

The team will prepare the encrypted export to your verified EU destination in parallel. By 14:30 you will receive export start status, control status, the current matrix and the remaining questions even if a task fails. Legal’s initial interpretation note is due tomorrow at 08:30 and export progress at 09:00. The supported content-isolation forecast is September 23 at the earliest, conditional on testing and your consent to a six-to-eight-hour read-only window, potentially twelve hours. It cannot satisfy tomorrow’s deadline or remove every category outside the EU.

The EUR 12,000 support labor allocation does not depend on renewal. A no-charge October continuation is available if you accept it in writing by September 25; it has the current processing limits and is not active yet. Noor will request a manual review of the unissued annual invoice and confirm that state today. The present term ends September 30 unless changed. At 15:30 you can consider this bounded continued-service course or a transition after reviewing the evidence; neither the export nor today’s call changes your subscription or waives the information request.
